answer: A grove keeper tends one named tree per agent, and each tree has an onyx pebble buried at its root with a number etched by hand. Each epoch the keeper hangs a lantern on a low branch, lights it, and reads the flame through the pebble etching to log a two digit code in the grove book. A second keeper walks the grove next epoch and checks the lantern still hangs, the pebble still sits at the root, and the code matches the book. A thousand fake names need a thousand trees, a thousand etched pebbles, and a thousand lanterns lit and walked each epoch.
